milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron ore vein is at (4-6, 0-2, 3) relative to spawn, approximately 6 blocks away. Using max_distance=5 forces the player to walk at least 1-2 blocks toward the iron ore rather than satisfying the milestone from spawn. Facing tolerance of 45 degrees ensures the player is deliberately looking at the iron ore blocks for visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lava pool is at (-9 to -6, -1, 6 to 9) relative to spawn, approximately 10 blocks away. Using max_distance=8 requires the player to walk several blocks toward the lava area. The lava is below floor level (-1) so the player needs to approach the edge to see it clearly. Facing tolerance of 45 degrees ensures they are oriented toward the lava pool.

Uses inventory_has because mining ancient debris with a diamond pickaxe (mining level 3, confirmed via wiki) drops the ancient_debris item which ends up in the player's inventory. There are 5 ancient debris blocks at (-6 to -9, 0-1, 5) near the lava pool. The player starts with a diamond pickaxe but no ancient_debris in inventory, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The stone brick stairs structure is at (8-12, 0-4, -10 to -7) with stairs specifically at (10, 0-1, -7 to -8), approximately 12 blocks from spawn. Using max_distance=5 forces the player to walk across the entire cave to reach the structure. Facing tolerance of 45 degrees ensures deliberate visual identification of the stairs.
